_header.purpose: Adversarial traces for the conversation guard, in the spirit of the repo's TLA+ work (D-020). The golden-day fixture exercises the golden path (their audit Note-2); these traces are counterexamples: each one tries to break a stated invariant. If a trace fails, the guard has a bug; if it holds, the invariant is re-proved against that attack.
_header.relation_to_tla: The lifecycle invariants (NoActiveWithoutSealed, EmergencyAlwaysPossible, RelaxationIsDelayed, DayReleaseIsBounded, InterruptedRecovers) stay in the repo's TLA+ artefacts. These are guard-local invariants with the same discipline. A real TLC counterexample can be exported and pasted here as steps + asserts; the runner is generic.
_header.how_to_add: Steps call a small registry of guard primitives (see tests/test_counterexamples.py). Asserts check one state field each. Every trace must have a documented attack story.

invariants.name: TighteningIsImmediate
invariants.attack_story: User breaches during a clean streak and hopes the taper 'averages out' over the week so tomorrow starts relaxed.

invariants.name: RelaxationIsDelayed
invariants.attack_story: Two clean days, then the user expects the stage to drop anyway; and after relaxing, expects another drop on day one of the next streak.

invariants.name: DebtIsBounded
invariants.attack_story: Hammer 500 off-scope holds in one session and hope the debt ceiling 10.0 is exceeded so the rebound pressure forces release.

invariants.name: DebtFrozenUnderFullLock
invariants.attack_story: Sit in FULL_LOCK accumulating debt from every held send so that when the window opens the debt explodes into a rebound binge.

invariants.name: ThreadInterlockHolds
invariants.attack_story: Open thread A, try to open thread B anyway; only disposal releases the key. Then try to use REDUCED_LOCK's single pivot to sneak a second thread in FULL_LOCK.

invariants.name: SidecarCannotUndercutDeterministicFloor
invariants.attack_story: A held prompt is already PARK_ONLY by the mode floor; the sidecar returns no escalation -- the user hopes the parked prompt is silently released.

invariants.name: NoSilentAllowOnBurst
invariants.attack_story: Burst to the threshold, pay nothing, and keep sending because the toll only 'suggests'.

invariants.name: BudgetCeilingOutranksEverything
invariants.attack_story: Exhaust the pass budget, then send an IN-scope prompt and hope in-scope status overrides the ceiling.
